summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## What I found investigating the path (read-only)  I traced client → API → module → DB and everything I could check *statically* looks correctly wired:  - **DB schema** (`modules/watchlist/schema.ts`): `watchlists` and `watchlist_items` are keyed by `user_id` / `watchlist_id`. No anonymous/guest/default-list concept. - **Handlers** (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`): every read and write (`GET /`, `POST /`, `GET /:id`, `PUT /:id`, `DELETE /:id`, item add/remove) filters or scopes by `getUserId(c)`, and ownership is re-checked on every item operation. No hardcoded or client-supplied user/
